title: observe() still reports a vanished SANDBOXES binding as "gone", sending the watch down the reboot path
body: The early return in observe() when sandboxBinding(env) is null reports process "gone", so supervisePass reboots; the replacement boot step then throws "the SANDBOXES binding disappeared mid-run", its retries exhaust, and the Workflow instance errors without finalize — the same answered-vs-failed-question honesty this tick establishes, at the binding rather than the process. Left out of scope because the tick names the getProcess catch specifically; reachable only when a deployment loses its binding mid-run.
